_comment: The kit's sections: the customer question each answers (its job, for the spec and the reason roast), the content it needs from the client, and what the visitor operates. Keep in step with kit/index.html, kit.css and kit.js (scripts/kit.mjs reads all four).

sections.name: hero-arch
sections.answers: What is this, for whom, what do I do, and what does it cost?
sections.needs: headline from the idea; one line of who/where; the main action; the real price; one photograph of the place, product or people; one drawing from the subject as the signature
sections.from: batch-007 Quite Nice (photo in an arch with drawn ingredients breaking the frame), batch-003 Swehl (arches)

sections.name: price-action
sections.answers: How much, what exactly do I get, and what happens when I pay?
sections.needs: the offer's name, the price and its unit, 3-5 inclusions, payment terms, the main action
sections.from: team Always rule: price near the main action (batch-002 Future)

sections.name: evidence-rows
sections.needs: 2-4 claims the page makes, each with its mechanism or number and a source the visitor can check
sections.operates: open a claim to read its proof (native details: keyboard and touch)
sections.from: batch-007 Quite Nice (benefit rows that open the mechanism and citations)

sections.name: reveal-cards
sections.needs: per offer: a picture of what it is and a picture of the result; name, price, time
sections.operates: a button (tap, keyboard) and hover where it exists swap the two pictures; without script both show
sections.from: batch-007 Quite Nice (packet to finished bowl), fixed for phones

sections.name: before-after
sections.needs: a real before and after of the same subject, with permission, unfiltered
sections.operates: a range slider (keyboard, touch) moves the split
sections.from: owner 2026-11-02 (before/after slider as an element the visitor operates)

sections.name: story-sticky
sections.needs: 3-5 steps in the customer's order; one photograph that stays beside them
sections.operates: none (the picture stays while the steps scroll; static under reduced motion)
sections.from: batch-003 Swehl (CSS sticky device), team Prefer: scroll storytelling with a static version

sections.name: proof-quote
sections.answers: Did it work for someone like me?
sections.needs: one real quote with full name, role or city, source and date; the rating with its count and date
sections.from: rules/defaults.md (one real quote, large, instead of three avatar cards)

sections.name: faq
sections.needs: 3-7 questions from customer voice (WhatsApp, reviews), each answered in two lines
sections.from: research method: customer questions in their words

sections.name: closing-action
sections.answers: How do I start, and when will I hear back?
sections.needs: the action, opening hours, response time, contact and address
sections.from: team Always rule: the action that pays on every screen
